page.overview:
What is Mathel?

Mathel is a location in Final Fantasy Dimensions. It is located to the south of Ashmonte. Most people that reside here are lumberjacks.

The Warriors of Light come accross this village after spotting an imperial ship and follow it. When the party first arrives, some people are talking about a shooting star which is due to Argy, who fell down from an imperial airship.
